_about: The ribbon flags' --alias table (kit/tools/ribbonflags.py, kit/docs/ribbon-flags.md): a ribbon card prints only the first part of a place (tools/build_family_lines.py head()), and the era snapshot holds the place as people.json prints it in full. Card text -> the place as src/data/era-places.json prints it. Written by hand; each entry's evidence is beside it. A name whose full form varies across people.json is not here.
_Briatico: people.json: every birth, death and marriage place that begins 'Briatico' is 'Briatico, Vibo Valentia, Calabria' (101) or the same with ', Italy' (13); era-places.json holds the first.
_Brisbane: people.json: every place that begins 'Brisbane' is 'Brisbane, Queensland' (29) or 'Brisbane, Queensland, Australia' (52); era-places.json holds the first.
_Wacol, Brisbane: story.json, chapter of 1959: the Queensland electoral roll of 1959 has Progress Road, Wacol, sub-district of Inala, 'on Brisbane's south-west edge'; Wacol is a suburb of Brisbane, so the era table's Brisbane, Queensland.
_Potenzoni (Briatico): people.json: all six places that begin 'Potenzoni (Briatico)' are 'Potenzoni (Briatico), Vibo Valentia, Calabria', a frazione of Briatico.
_Mandaradoni (Briatico): people.json: the one place that begins 'Mandaradoni (Briatico)' is 'Mandaradoni (Briatico), Vibo Valentia, Calabria', a frazione of Briatico.
_Potenzioni: people.json: the one place that begins 'Potenzioni' is 'Potenzioni, Catanzaro Calabria, Italy' (the export's spelling of Potenzoni; Briatico was in Catanzaro province until 1996); era-places.json holds it.
